authorship_contamination_policy: For each task, exclude its author model family. The remaining two distinct model families supply all three cohorts, preserving two models per cohort without subject-family or author-family exposure.
deterministic_two_family_selection: After excluding the author family, use both families when two remain. When three remain, select adjacent families in declared order with offset (final task number - 1) modulo 3. The same two families are used for weak, medium, and frontier configurations.
selection_policy: Accept only complete, provenance-bound observations; revise or replace rejected items without exposing accepted candidates to Luna or Sol.
